newsitem.title: USA: TWA late in airport rent, landing fees - paper.
newsitem.headline: TWA late in airport rent, landing fees - paper.

text.p: Trans World Airlines is months behind in rent and landing fee payments to some U.S. airports, USA Today said on Thursday.
Last week, San Francisco airport sent TWA a 30-day termination notice because the airline owed about $1 million for rent this year, the paper said.
TWA, which was not immediately available to comment, was quoted in the paper as saying the reports of delinquent payments were "nonsense."
Dallas/Fort Worth airport officials have sent letters and repeatedly called the airline's headquarters in order to get a $196,000 payment, the paper said.
An airport spokeswoman was quoted in the paper as saying TWA had not made a payment since December.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, TWA said its consolidated cash and cash equivalents balance at the end of 1996 was $181.6 million, down from $304.3 million on December 31, 1995.
